title: cargo doc reports six warnings on libsail
body:
`cargo doc --workspace --all-features --no-deps` reports six warnings on `libsail` at ab97b44:

- the doc on `index::EXTENSION` links `Index::path_for`, but `path_for` is a free function
- an unresolved link to `Index::save_as`
- the module doc of `index` and the doc on `VALID` link the private items `scan` and `frame`
- `format` is both a module and a macro
close_reason: Landed in 473397a on dev. cargo doc reports no warnings, with default features and with --all-features.
